ModMetaData.name: Drafted Command Priority
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Drafted Command Priority makes explicit player-forced jobs authoritative while a player-controlled pawn is drafted. If a drafted pawn is currently executing a playerForced job, ordinary non-player-forced jobs are prevented from replacing it through Pawn_JobTracker.StartJob. This includes normal autonomous fire/flee/AI reactions that would otherwise steal control. Optional Melee Pawn Auto Attack lets drafted pawns holding melee weapons automatically attack nearby hostile pawns when they have no player-forced order; the acquisition radius is configurable from 1 to 20 cells, default 4. The protection ends automatically when the forced order ends or the pawn is undrafted. Downed and mental-state pawns are not locked by the patch. RimWorld 1.5.
